# Crossa

Crossa is a C++20 compiler and native client runtime for typed `.cra` projects. It validates shared mobile client behavior and generates Android AAR and iOS XCFramework APIs backed by one native execution path.

## Primary resources

- [Documentation](/docs): Verified Crossa V0 documentation
- [Getting started](/docs/getting-started/introduction): Product and compiler introduction
- [First project](/docs/getting-started/first-project): End-to-end project setup
- [Language overview](/docs/language/overview): `.cra` syntax and scope
- [Networking](/docs/networking/overview): Request execution and policy
- [Android integration](/docs/android/integration): Generated AAR workflow
- [iOS integration](/docs/ios/integration): Generated XCFramework workflow
- [Architecture](/docs/architecture/system-overview): Compiler, runtime and platform boundaries
- [Benchmarks](/benchmarks): Retained release observations and raw samples
- [Repositories](/repositories): Core and example source repositories
